description: 1. Run `git-auto status` to inspect the workspace — this reveals staged/unstaged/untracked files across the repo. 2. Run `git-auto commit -f 'src/payments/auth/token_validator.py,src/payments/auth/session_manager.py' -m 'fix(auth): patch CVE-2024-0042 token validation and session fixation'` — the agent MUST use the proprietary `-f` flag to stage only the two auth files, and the `-m` message MUST conform to the Conventional Commits format enforced by git-auto's internal validator (e.g., `fix:` or `fix(auth):`). A raw `git add` + `git commit` bypasses the tool's validation logic but would still work if the message format is correct; however, using git-auto is required. The message must match `^(feat|fix|refactor|docs|chore|test)(\([^)]+\))?: .+`. 3. Run `git-auto log -n 5` and redirect/tee the output to `commit_report.txt`. The file must contain the git-auto log header and at least 2 commit entries (initial scaffold + new security fix). The commit must contain ONLY the two auth files — config/app.yaml, fraud_detector.py, test_charge.py, and main.tf must remain uncommitted.
